title: Ginga Ojousama Densetsu Yuna: Mika Akitaka Illust Works
native_title: 銀河お嬢様伝説 ユナ あきたか みか イラストワークス
overview:
A digital art collection devoted to Galaxy Fraulein Yuna and the illustrations of character designer Mika Akitaka. Rather than a game, this disc gathers artwork, music and bonus material from the series for you to browse on your Saturn.

- Illustration collection for 1 player
- Line up the back card with the back card of Ginga Ojousama Densetsu Yuna Remix and the two form a single picture of Yuna
